title: Natural-based catalysts for 5-hydroxymethylfurfural production from cane syrup for pharmaceutical applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4420-4431
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08563B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nattee Akkarawatkhoosith, Rathakron Suknasaeng, Yada Chaiyasit, Attasak Jaree, Tiprawee Tongtummachat
Naturally derived carboxylic acids (citric, malic, acetic, and lactic) were used as non-toxic catalysts to produce pharmaceutical-grade 5-HMF from cane syrup, providing a safer and more sustainable alternative to conventional methods.
